name: Term Loan Scheme (GTKVN)
benefit: - **Loan Amount:** Loans up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided for eligible small businesses.- **Interest Rate:** Interest on the loan will be charged at 6% up to ₹5,00,000/-.- **Loan Coverage:** Government share 95% of project cost, and beneficiary share 5% margin money- **Loan Tenure:**	The loan amount will have to be repaid in 60 equal monthly installments including interest.- **Guarantor:** One guar
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Thakor or Koli community. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant’s age should be between 21 and 50 years. 1. The applicant must have experience/skilled in the proposed trade or business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. > **Note:** At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families with annual income up to ₹1,50,000/-.
